violation_type.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §744.801(2))
violation_type.short_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records
violation_type.typical_finding: Personnel files to include training were not available on site during the inspection on November 1, 2022. Training records have been requested via email and have not been provided to CCR.

finding_variants.text: Personnel files to include training were not available on site during the inspection on November 1, 2022. Training records have been requested via email and have not been provided to CCR.
Personnel and training records were not available for review.
Three caregivers do not have any personnel records or trainings on file.
Personnel and training records were unavailable at inspection.
Multiple record keeping items were not made available to the Child Care Regulation Inspector for review at the time of the monitoring inspection.
The operation has one caregiver with no staff file.
